semantic_sign_minus1.question: Does the central part of the patch differ markedly from most of its perimeter?
Do neighboring vegetated areas have markedly different false-color tones?
Does a vegetated area contain irregular patches with a weaker vegetation signal?
Are vegetation patches connected only by narrow visible necks?
Is one field-like parcel visibly different from all its immediate neighbors?
Does a field-like parcel contain an irregular area of weaker vegetation?
Do several field-like parcels meet without visible woody boundaries?
Does the density of built-looking surfaces decrease gradually toward open ground?
